name: project-osmos
description: > Orchestrate Project Osmos for long-running Fabric and OneLake data-engineering outcomes, including task status, messages, follow-ups, cancellation, and deletion. Osmos tasks are remote service tasks, not local background agents. In Fabric portal Copilot, direct interaction is unsupported; point users to GitHub Copilot CLI. Use spark-cli for direct non-Osmos Spark work. Triggers: "Project Osmos", "Project Osmos task status", "check my Osmos task".
